verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents the mute/ignore part of the story: errors can be snoozed or ignored, dashboard discard rules can be synced to SDKs, and before-notify callbacks can drop events. Daily-quota 'rate limiting' and event-usage controls exist, but they govern billing quota rather than alert noise, so they are only adjacent to spike protection. missing for 10: alert-level spike protection or notification throttling, per-key/per-project rate limits, evidence that snooze/ignore suppresses PagerDuty/Slack pages, hands-on corroboration.
